headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas let you tag why you took each trade, show when several open trades add up to one big bet, and flag movers that are being pushed by liquidations.

ideas.title: Tag why you took each trade
ideas.why: After each import, the bot asks one tap per trade: Plan / Chased / Revenge / Bored. /week then shows PnL by tag. tilt.py spots revenge by timing; this adds your own honest reason, so you see exactly what 'Chased' and 'Bored' trades cost you.

ideas.title: Total exposure warning in the tilt guard
ideas.why: Alts tend to fall together when the market drops, so 3 alt longs at 20× are really one big bet. The guard already reads your open positions: add up their size and the loss if all hit their stops together, and warn when it passes your daily limit.

ideas.title: "Liq burst" flag on scanner cards
ideas.why: Some top movers are being pushed by forced liquidations, not new buyers, and the book is thin while it happens. Binance's free liquidation stream can show 'shorts liquidated: 180k USDT in 15 min' on a card, so you don't enter in the middle of forced flow.
